description: Main entry point for a Flutter application implementing a diet planner and calorie tracker. It initializes environment variables, loads food data through a service, and sets up the root widget with theme and provider configurations.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up theme, dependency injection via providers, and routes based on authentication status.

methods.name: _buildTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a customized ThemeData object for the app's theme.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp, setting up providers and routing based on authentication state.
